message.content:
Since \(2\) and \(9\) are relatively prime, multiply both sides of

\[
2x \equiv y+5 \pmod 9
\]

by the inverse of \(2\) modulo \(9\). The inverse is \(5\), because \(2\cdot 5=10\equiv 1\pmod 9\).

So,

\[
x \equiv 5(y+5)\pmod 9
\]

\[
x \equiv 5y+25\pmod 9
\]

Since \(25\equiv 7\pmod 9\),

\[
x \equiv 5y+7\pmod 9
\]

Thus the blanks are \(5\) and \(7\), and their product is

\[
5\cdot 7=35
\]

The answer is 35.
